The Middle East crisis and the resulting blockade of the Strait of Hormuz has caused supply disruptions for the globe, which can potentially lead to catastrophic consequences for modern civilization. The global economy, agriculture, energy production, and transportation infrastructure rely heavily on oil products such as petrol, diesel and liquified natural gas. So, is life without oil possible? A 4-part human interest series tries to answer this question as the filmmakers traverse Pakistan, Bangladesh, India, and Philippines to meet communities, governments and entrepreneurs building the future of human civilization with renewable energies like solar, biogas, organic fertilizers, and electric vehicles. We understand if this quiet transformation across Asia is sustainable and if life without oil can one day become a reality.

Azizah is the founder for Bayu Textiles, the leading fabrics company in the industry. She is known for her success and unyielding control. When her eldest son, Amir, marries Emilia, a successful young entrepreneur, Azizah's world begins to crumble. She considers Emilia a rival in both business and family life. Tensions mount as the two women engage in a high stakes battle for power, love, and legacy.

A drama series about the students of SMK Ayer Dalam, who lives are turned upside down when they learn that their school is at risk of being demolished. Putting aside their differences, Alya, Asma, Boi and their friends join forces with thier discipline teacher, Cikgu Azza, to save their beloved school. Along the way, they discover the true meaning of friendship, teamwork and standing up for what matters most.
A docuseries exploring Sarawak’s traditional medicinal plants and healing practices through the wisdom of shamans and practitioners who continue to preserve this ancient knowledge.

In Air Tangan, family bonds are rekindled as generations come together to rediscover cherished family recipes. Watch a Gen Z influencer embark on a culinary adventure with their elder relative, who teaches them the art of traditional Malay cooking while the younger generation introduces modern and fusion dishes. As they cook together, they share personal stories, reminisce childhood memories, and delve into the cultural significance of each dish. Dalam siri Air Tangan, dua generasi berbeza bersatu dan mengukuhkan ikatan keluarga serta memasak resipi keluarga turun temurun. Saksikan pempengaruh Gen Z belajar memasak daripada warga emas dalam keluarga mereka. Pempengaruh itu akan memperkenalkan hidangan moden dan fusion kepada nenek atau Ibu saudara mereka. Sambil memasak bersama, mereka berkongsi kisah peribadi, mengimbas kenangan silam dan menyelami resipi dan asal usul setiap hidangan.
Traveling to different locations to find hidden, delicious and popular foods. Host: Nizam Jentik Jentik in Kajang, KL
Catch the latest local and international news on Suria.

Kek & Pastri features Dr Ezani and Nabila Huda creating innovative desserts and pastries inspired by local ingredients, especially from Sarawak. Each episode is enlivened by celebrity guests, lighthearted situations and humour, while sharing simple techniques, creative recipe improvisations and delicious modern treats suitable for all audiences.
Sherry Al Hadad is on a mission to entertain her celebrity friends, but she has zero cooking skills! She turns to foster mum, Datin Marlia Musa for help.
Mia discovers that the mysterious songwriter, Isaac, is actually her neighbour, Is Hamdan. Meanwhile, the stalker’s obsession escalates, and Jay makes an alarming discovery in Mal’s room.

Juri gives viewers an insight into the legal process and procedures surrounding highly publicized cases that have shock the nation. Hear the recounts from prolific lawyers who shares with us what happens during these incidents as well as professionals, giving you private access to delve further into the case. Juri menyelongkar kes-kes mahkamah yang telah mendapat banyak perhatian. Dengarkan huraian daripada para peguam dan pakar tentang undang-undang dan tatacara disebalik kes-kes ini.

Don't miss the continuing adventures as Beyblade pros from around the world gather to compete in the Pro League held inside the X Tower!
A docuseries exploring Sarawak’s traditional medicinal plants and healing practices through the wisdom of shamans and practitioners who continue to preserve this ancient knowledge.
Tom loves caring for his friends; they can always count on Tom to tow them back to his car wash, where they're guaranteed to leave sparking!

An oddball buddy series between an over ambitious boy, Jack and his pal Moose, a melodramatic self-confessed expert in everything. Except he isn't! Despite his best intentions, he always messes up and although Jack may not get what he want, you can't help being sucked in by Moose's relentless optimism and zest for life!

Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

When a tooth falling out turns into a hunt for the “giant mouse”, when the city’s sewers transform into Indiana Jones’ white rapids or when a trip to the toilets becomes an expedition to a haunted house, well then you’ve entered the wonderful world of Eliot Kid!

The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.
Great Projects From Ordinary Cardboard!
Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!
Max Green’s new brother and sister are aliens sent to Earth as the advance party for an invasion - and he’s the only one who can stop them turning humans into unwilling slave-gardeners.

The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

Gummy lives in an apartment with his friend Harry the Chameleon, while his other friend Kala the Cat hangs out in a ninja dojo on the roof. Together they go on wild and wacky adventures in their building and hometown. Enjoy the fun and crazy adventures!

Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!
Things get even more epic in Season 3 as Talking Tom and Friends try new ways to make their dreams come true, making more friends (and enemies) along the way!
Meet the Monster Trucks, a gang of colossal, hard-working cars who team up to help their friends and community in Monster City.

Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

p.t: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
p.d: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

p.t: Flashpoint - Greatest Performance in Olympic History
p.d: They are among the most emblematic images of sport. When Usain Bolt erupted onto the Olympic scene, when a Super Bowl was stolen and the Butler did it, when Wayne Rooney stupefied Sir Alex Ferguson.
The 2012 Ryder Cup was exceptional, just like the incredible year 2013 of Inbee Park, while Tiger Woods has changed the sport. As for Augusta National, it's a veritable icon.

Leonardo Bonucci is keeping the great tradition of Italian central defenders alive. Goran Pandev retires as a legend, and we discover the stars who pay as much attention to their hairstyles as their skills!
Golfer John Daly is the "Wild Thing" of the fairways, Babe Ruth and Babe Dirikson encounter a trickster in a crazy golfing exhibition and Sergio Garcia's bad attitude.

The hour of glory for Lebron James could be the return to the 2016 NBA finals, Steph Curry has been an NBA gamechanger, Sue Bird and Diana Taurasi form a deathly duo and Gregg Popovich is the best NBA winner of all time.
The Olympic 100 metres is the flagship event of the Games, Usain Bolt carried off the gold medal, Sally Pearson shocked the world and Iten, in Kenya, is the training camp among the clouds.
China is the undeniable superpower of world diving, with Wu Minxia reigning as the queen of the pool. Meanwhile, Tom Daley stands as an Olympic legend, and Chen Ruolin was unbeaten for over a decade.

Jason and Laura Kenny were the number one husband and wife duo of the Olympic Games, they directed a group of British cyclists on the track in 2008 and 2012, while Nino Schurter, the great mountain bike specialist, has a full list of achievements.

Michael Johnson was untouchable over 200m, Cathy Freeman's gold in 2000 brought a nation to a halt, Mo Farah carried off the double-double twice, while the double amputee Oscar Pistorius was part of the 2012 Olympic team.

China's Eillen Gu became the queen of the snows at the Winter Olympics of 2022, Jamaica's bobsleigh team inspired a film, the big names of downhill skiing take it easy, while Shaun White has appropriated the snowboard half-pipe.

From London to Paris via Johannesburg, Terroll Lewis, aka Boost, covers the world to popularise his discipline, Block Workout. This former bad boy has chosen fitness to get back on the straight and narrow, founding his own discipline, which involves bodybuilding using solely the body and the urban environment.

The greatest moments in the history of sport… When Sergio Aguero ended his first season in the Premier League with a final goal. When Hammerin' Hank overtook Babe and became an icon of civil rights. Here are the stories hidden behind the most famous photos of sporting celebrities.

The Wimbledon 2008 men's final is considered as the greatest of all time… Roland Garros is an emblematic place…. Naomi Osaka is a citizen of world tennis while Novak Djokovic has made history in Australia.

Megan Rapinoe fought against Donald Trump. Vinnie Jones attempted to break through in Hollywood. And after having tried their luck elsewhere, Cristiano Ronaldo and Antoine Griezmann have gone back where they belong.

p.t: Foul Play - When Nick Met Bernard
p.d: Australian tennis terrors Nick Kyrios and Bernard Tomic, American superbrat John McEnroe loses his cool and Andre Agassi falls to a historic low.
